title: protocol error payload
description: Sent by the platform when a message violates the protocol. Per-operation errors (unknown_operation, state_conflict) leave the connection open; connection-level errors (unsupported_protocol_version, session_replaced, stale_sequence, sequence_gap, robot_mismatch, conflicting_operation, malformed_message) are followed by a close with status 4402 (unsupported_protocol_version) or 4409 (all other connection-level errors) or 4401 when the credential is rejected at connection time.
